topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: Different indexes may include the same securities. Or, indexes could give more weight to certain securities than you might expect.
question: Misconception: If two non-traditional index funds track different indexes, their holdings cannot overlap, so owning both automatically ensures diversification. What is the correction?
answer: Different indexes can include some of the same securities, and an index may give certain securities more weight than expected. So, different index names alone do not guarantee that the funds add diversification. Look through each fund to its actual holdings to assess overlap and concentration.
